label: One-being controls for the Dei Filius sufficiency bridges, checked
meaning: Nonvacuity: the premises of nineGiveDeiFilius are jointly satisfiable with a being that has the nine and every Dei Filius attribute. Necessity in that theorem: for each of its ten premises except goodness-is-actuality, a one-being interpretation satisfies all the others and the nine at the one being, while some Dei Filius attribute fails there; so none of those nine premises is supplied by the rest. Strictness: an interpretation where the field interpretation holds vacuously (no Dei Filius being) while the old sufficiency premise fails. Model-witnessed facts about these interpretations only; they show where each premise is needed, not that it is false or doubtful.
